premise: Working primarily as a carpenter for Hollywood directors until a chance carpentry job on a casting set led to his audition for Star Wars.
hook: He was building cabinets for George Lucas's office when he was suddenly asked to read lines for other auditioning actors.
key_facts: Worked extensively as a professional carpenter in Los Angeles to support his young family.
Built cabinets for the home of director George Lucas prior to casting Star Wars.
Cast as Han Solo after initially participating only to help read dialogue for other actors.

premise: The split-second decision to remain seated on a Montgomery bus that ignited the Civil Rights Movement.
hook: She didn't plan to start a historic movement that afternoon; her feet were simply tired, and she refused to move.
key_facts: Arrested on December 1, 1955, in Montgomery, Alabama, for refusing to obey a bus driver's order.
Her arrest triggered the successful 381-day Montgomery bus boycott.
Worked as a seamstress and served as secretary for the Montgomery branch of the NAACP.

premise: Overcoming severe scoliosis and chronic hamstring injuries to become the fastest human in history.
hook: Doctors told him a severe spinal curvature would make professional sprinting nearly impossible.
key_facts: Diagnosed with scoliosis, a condition that caused his spine to curve and one leg to be shorter than the other.
Won eight Olympic gold medals across three consecutive Olympic Games.
Set world records in the 100-meter and 200-meter sprints at the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

premise: Rising from the chess clubs of Southern India to shatter the Soviet domination of world chess.
hook: He learned the game from his mother in a small town before global databases or chess computers existed.
key_facts: Became India's first grandmaster in 1988 at the age of 18.
Won the FIDE World Chess Championship five times.
Earned the nickname 'The Tiger of Madras' for his exceptionally fast playing style.

premise: Reinventing the high jump at the 1968 Mexico City Olympics with a radical, upside-down technique.
hook: Every coach told him his backward jumping style was dangerous and useless, until he won Olympic gold.
key_facts: Introduced the 'Fosbury Flop' technique to international competition.
Won the gold medal in high jump at the 1968 Summer Olympics.
Permanently changed how athletes approach the high jump discipline worldwide.

premise: A textile factory worker and amateur parachutist selected to become the first woman in space.
hook: She kept her secret training mission hidden from her own mother until the launch was broadcast globally.
key_facts: Worked as a spinner in a local textile mill before joining the cosmonaut corps.
Piloted the Vostok 6 mission in June 1963.
Remains the only woman to have flown a solo space mission.

premise: Transitioning from quantum chemistry to molecular biology and global activism after a passport revocation.
hook: When the US government confiscated his passport during the Cold War, it accidentally changed his life's mission.
key_facts: Won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1954 for his research into the nature of chemical bonds.
Awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1962 for his campaign against atmospheric nuclear testing.
One of the few people in history to win two unshared Nobel Prizes in different fields.
